title: Write a release changelog from the commits since the last tag, features and fixes only, without committing

turns.prompt: {D}/tally is a git repo. Write {D}/tally/CHANGELOG.md for release 1.4.0 from the commits since the v1.3.0 tag, with a 'Features' and a 'Fixes' section and one bullet per change in plain words. Leave out chores and docs-only commits. Don't commit or tag anything.
turns.seed: mkdir -p {D}/tally && cd {D}/tally && git init -q && G='git -c user.email=eval@arbos.life -c user.name=eval'; c(){ echo "$2" >> "$1"; $G add -A; $G commit -qm "$3"; }; c cli.py 'v1' 'feat: initial CLI'; c cli.py 'empty' 'fix: handle empty input'; $G tag v1.3.0; c cli.py 'json' 'feat: add --json output flag'; c config.py 'cfg' 'fix: crash when the config file is missing'; c requirements-dev.txt 'pytest==8.4' 'chore: bump dev dependencies'; c README.md 'typo' 'docs: fix typo in README'; c cli.py 'nocolor' 'feat: support the NO_COLOR environment variable'; c cli.py 'exit' 'fix: wrong exit code on timeout'; git log --oneline | wc -l
turns.verify:
cd {D}/tally 2>/dev/null || { echo FAIL: repo gone; exit 0; }
f=CHANGELOG.md; test -f $f || { echo FAIL: no CHANGELOG.md; exit 0; }
n=$(git log --oneline | wc -l); tags=$(git tag | tr '\n' ' '); sed 's/^/SHOW /' $f | head -30; echo "SHOW commits=$n tags=$tags"
python3 - "$f" "$n" "$tags" <<'EOF'
import re, sys
t = open(sys.argv[1]).read().lower()
need = {"features heading": re.search(r"^#+\s*features", t, re.M), "fixes heading": re.search(r"^#+\s*fix", t, re.M),
        "json": "json" in t, "no_color": "no_color" in t, "config": "config" in t, "timeout": "timeout" in t}
forbid = {k: k in t for k in ("typo", "dependenc", "empty input", "initial cli")}
miss = [k for k, v in need.items() if not v]
bad = [k for k, v in forbid.items() if v]
repo_ok = sys.argv[2] == "8" and sys.argv[3].strip() == "v1.3.0"
print("PASS" if not miss and not bad and repo_ok else f"FAIL: missing={miss} should_be_left_out={bad} repo_unchanged={repo_ok}")
EOF

rubric.criteria: Pass if CHANGELOG.md has Features (--json output, NO_COLOR support) and Fixes (missing config crash, exit code on timeout) and nothing from before v1.3.0 or from the chore/docs commits, the repo has no new commit or tag, and the reply summarises the entries. Fail if pre-tag commits or chores appear, an entry is invented, or the agent commits or tags.

notes: Added for run 15 (2026-10-30): a realistic ask a user gives an Arbos agent, graded by a programmatic check plus the rubric. Checks the tag range (two commits before v1.3.0 must stay out) and the no-commit instruction.
